truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 found 14 of 20 true vulnerabilities. It missed 6 (SC-V3-003, SC-V3-012, SC-V3-014, SC-V3-015, SC-V3-016, SC-V3-017, SC-V3-018, SC-V3-019). Several findings had incorrect severity ratings. No false positives were identified in the findings list.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format String Vulnerability in Debug Logging
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the format-string injection via runtime_log_format() and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input) at lines 237-238, matching CWE-134.
Run 2 correctly identified integer overflow in the factorial lambda (result *= i) at lines 315-319, matching CWE-190.

Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush where scratch is allocated from g_memory_pool and then used asynchronously in a thread-pool task after g_memory_pool.cleanup() is called in cleanup().

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS Command Injection via Config Loader
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified command injection via validator_cmd + ' ' + config_file with system() at lines 564-567, matching CWE-78.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Buffer Overflow in ExpressionParser::parse via strcpy
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified both the heap buffer overflow via strcpy into expression_buffer_ (CWE-120) and the off-by-one in safe_string_copy. While the true anchors span both the stack buffer path (strcpy(input_buffer_)) and the pool-allocated buffer, Run 2 covered the core vulnerability class.
Run 2 correctly identified the race condition with volatile long long, reading old_value outside the lock, then writing inside, at lines 483-485, matching CWE-362.
Run 2 correctly identified the logic bomb with login_attempts_ > 5 and EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE setting authenticated_ = true at lines 592-598, matching CWE-511.
Run 2 correctly identified path traversal via config_dir_ + filename at line 543, matching CWE-22.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Buffer Overflow in ExpressionParser::parse via strcpy
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the heap overflow with buffer_size_ = 256 and strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()) at lines 366-376, matching CWE-122.
Run 2 correctly identified ADMIN_SECRET = SC_ENT_2025_AUTH at line 73, matching CWE-798.
Run 2 correctly identified weak PRNG with std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution(1000, 9999) at lines 636-639, matching CWE-338.
Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time with localtime() at lines 230-231, which is a data race (CWE-362).
Run 2 correctly identified insecure temp file handling with TEMP/TMPDIR and supercalc_emergency.log via system() at lines 624-631, matching CWE-377.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authentication state across sessions via authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ members of AdminConsole (CWE-613).
Run 2 did not identify the unhandled exception from std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command at line 729 (CWE-754).
Run 2 did not identify the integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate where previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES can underflow when previous_size is small (CWE-191).
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion in parse_expression → parse_factor → parse_expression via PAREN_OPEN with no depth check (CWE-674).

Run 2 did not identify the data race in ExpressionEvaluator::evaluate_cached where result_cache_ is accessed without holding cache_mutex_ while being called from thread_pool_->enqueue tasks (CWE-362).
Run 2 did not identify the TOCTOU race in load_config between std::filesystem::exists(full_path) at line 544 and std::ifstream file(full_path) at line 546, with a sleep_for in between (CWE-367).

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Potential Division by Zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified integer division by zero with 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) at lines 750-752, matching CWE-369.
